name: The Modern JavaScript Tutorial
summary: Open-source, book-style JavaScript tutorial: from basics to advanced language and browser topics, with tasks and examples.
description: A free, book-style tutorial covering JavaScript as a language (fundamentals, code quality, objects, prototypes, classes, error handling, promises and async/await, generators, modules) and the browser (DOM, events, forms, network requests, animation, Web components, regular expressions). Created in 2007 by Ilya Kantor and maintained as an open-source project with translations into 15+ languages; the full text is also sold as an EPUB/PDF ebook of about 1,300 pages.
contains: 2 main parts: the JavaScript language and browser (Document, Events, Interfaces), plus additional articles
15 interface languages incl. EN, RU, ZH, ES, FR, TR
tasks and runnable examples in the chapters
open-source project with 25,495 GitHub stars (as crawled)
